title: An exponential inequality with base greater than 1
source: P23 Ch2 theory P23-2.6 Quick check 1 (3^x>20, k=2.73 to 3 s.f.)
stem: The inequality {a|int} to the power x is greater than {N|int} can be written as x greater than k. What is k, correct to 3 significant figures?

steps.name: form
steps.text_tex: Taking logarithms to base 10, x times the logarithm of {a|int} is greater than the logarithm of {N|int}. The logarithm of {a|int} is positive, so the symbol is unchanged.
steps.note: Take logs; keep the inequality symbol.

steps.name: E
steps.text_tex: The critical value k is {E|sf3z} to 3 significant figures.

title: An exponential inequality with base between 0 and 1
source: P23 Ch2 theory P23-2.6 Quick check 2 (0.4^x<0.1, k=2.51 to 3 s.f.)
stem: The inequality 0.{p|int} to the power x is less than 0.{q|int} can be written as x greater than k. What is k, correct to 3 significant figures?

steps.name: form
steps.text_tex: Taking logarithms, x times the logarithm of 0.{p|int} is less than the logarithm of 0.{q|int}. The logarithm of 0.{p|int} is negative, so the inequality symbol is reversed.
steps.note: Take logs and reverse when dividing by a negative logarithm.

steps.name: E
steps.text_tex: The critical value k is {E|sf3z} to 3 significant figures.

title: An exponential inequality with a constant factor
source: P23 Ch2 theory P23-2.6 Quick check 3 (4 times 3^x>20, k=1.46 to 3 s.f.)
stem: The inequality {c|int} times {a|int} to the power x is greater than {N|int} can be written as x greater than k. What is k, correct to 3 significant figures?

steps.name: form
steps.text_tex: Dividing by {c|int} gives {a|int} to the power x greater than {R|num2}. Taking logarithms, k is the logarithm of that value divided by the logarithm of {a|int}.
steps.note: Divide by the constant, then take logs.

steps.name: E
steps.text_tex: The critical value k is {E|sf3z} to 3 significant figures.
